profile.name: Fabricio López Reyes
profile.role: Software Developer | C · C++ · Python · JavaScript · TypeScript · React · Linux · Docker | 42 Madrid Graduate
profile.bio: Software Developer graduated from 42 Madrid, trained through intensive project-based programming in languages and tools including C, C++, TypeScript, Docker, Linux, and Git, with high autonomy and strong team-collaboration skills. Programming teacher (Python, JavaScript, C, C++, OOP), cultivating my ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively. Experienced in founding the MVP for QWAK and winning high-impact hackathons (HackSat 2026, Merge Hackathon Mastercard challenge, Telefónica's LaCabina Special Award), driven to build reliable, scalable tech products with real-world impact.

experience.title: Programming Teacher & Administrative Assistant
experience.description: Teaching programming classes to beginner and intermediate students in Python, Scratch, and game development. Fostering logical thinking, problem solving, and creativity tailored to each group's pace. Administrative support managing class schedules, academic monitoring, and parent communication.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Developer
experience.description: Co-founder developing a supply chain visibility platform with color-flagged alerts and checkpoints to improve communication between drivers and logistics operations. Engineered the MVP using TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Docker, MongoDB, and Telefónica OpenGateway network APIs (Device Swap, Location, KYC, Roaming). Validated product with early users and structured roadmap.

experience.title: Software Programming Instructor
experience.description: Personalized 1-on-1 programming instruction across all age groups. Designed tailored learning plans covering Python, JavaScript, C, and C++, focusing on object-oriented programming, manual memory management, segmentation fault debugging, and core data structures.
